title: Falcons GM Ian Cunningham confirms plan to release Kirk Cousins

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Falcons GM: QB Cousins to be released March 11
sources.description: New Falcons GM Ian Cunningham has informed QB Kirk Cousins that the team will release him March 11, the first day of the league year, Cunningham said Tuesday on 92.9 The Game.

sources.description: Cousins is expected to be released on the first day of the 2026 league year.
